name: Successful logon
description: Type 2=interactive · Type 3=network · Type 9=runas · Type 10=RDP

name: Failed logon
description: Password spray · brute force identification

name: Explicit credential
description: runas / Pass-the-Hash preparation indicator

name: Logoff
description: Session end - use to calculate session duration

name: User initiated logoff
description: Explicit logout vs. session timeout

name: Special privileges
description: Admin logon → track all Domain Admin interactive sessions

name: NTLM auth validation
description: Should be rare if Kerberos enforced - NTLM use is suspicious

name: Account created
description: Unauthorized new user account creation

name: Member added to global grp
description: Domain Admins membership change - always alert

name: Member added to univ grp
description: Enterprise Admins / high-priv group membership

name: User account changed
description: Pre-auth disabled (AS-REP roastable) · PwdNotRequired flag

name: SID History added
description: Privilege escalation via SID History injection

name: Password change attempt
description: Self-service reset · verify intent

name: Password reset attempt
description: Admin reset of another account - verify authorization

name: Kerberos AS ticket (TGT)
description: AS-REP roast: accounts with pre-auth disabled

name: Kerberos service ticket
description: Kerberoast: etype 0x17 (RC4) for service accounts

name: Kerberos ticket renewed
description: Anomalous renewal patterns

name: Kerberos pre-auth failed
description: Kerberos equivalent of failed password spray (4625)

name: AD object access
description: DCSync: mask 0x100 on Domain object from non-DC source

name: Computer account created
description: Unauthorized machine account (resource-based delegation abuse)

name: Computer account changed
description: Service Principal Name changes → potential Kerberoast setup

name: Certificate issued
description: Monitor all issuances for privileged account templates

name: Certificate issued with SAN
description: ESC1 exploitation: SAN containing privileged UPN

name: Certificate template modified
description: ESC4 attack: template modification for exploitation

name: Process created
description: Must enable + command line audit policy for full value

name: Scheduled task created
description: Attacker persistence - inspect task action and author

name: New service installed
description: PsExec / attacker service drop - review binary path

name: Process Create
description: Hashes + full command line + parent process + user context

name: File time changed
description: Anti-forensic timestomping detection

name: Network Connect
description: Process→IP/domain with port. C2 beacon correlation source

name: Process terminated
description: Malware self-delete pattern (short-lived malicious processes)

name: Image loaded
description: DLL load with hash and signature status. Detect unsigned DLLs

name: CreateRemoteThread
description: Cross-process injection - high confidence IOC when unexpected

name: ProcessAccess
description: GrantedAccess 0x1FFFFF / 0x1010 from non-AV = LSASS dump

name: FileCreate
description: Malware dropping files to disk - monitor temp and user paths

name: RegistryCreateKey
description: Registry key creation - Run keys, services, COM entries

name: RegistrySetValue
description: Registry value modification - persistence mechanism monitoring

name: FileCreateStreamHash
description: NTFS Alternate Data Stream creation - hiding data in streams

name: PipeCreated
description: Named pipe creation - Cobalt Strike default pipe names detectable

name: PipeConnected
description: Named pipe connection - lateral movement via named pipes (PsExec)

name: DNSEvent
description: DNS query + requesting process. C2-over-DNS detection anchor

name: FileDelete (archive)
description: Malware deleting itself after execution

name: ProcessTampering
description: Process image hollowing / herpaderping / doppelgänging
